content.text:
## Fractal Sky - The Aquarius, Pt II

_Gravitas Recordings, Austin, Texas, USA_

  

Fractal Sky (aka, "Aaron Spence") and I first met up as musicians, at not one but two different SXSW events in the ATX. Gravitas held that second one, and Fractal Sky nearly brought down the house with his retro hip-hop beats that night. Bredd and I still talk about it to this day.

  

It's a testament to how segmented my circles and arts are that, years later, when he came across my fractal art it didn't even trigger his memory of me as a musician. Until I reminded him of that night. "OMG," he wrote. "Y'all nearly caused a riot that night!"

  

When he asked me to be a part in the single for "Aquarius II", I was all-in!

  

### About the Fractal Sky Logo

Intertwining it and bringing new energy and life to the symbol. Symbol meaning: The 4 circles represent the 4 elements in which Empedocles called "roots" (air, water, fire, earth). These "roots" intertwine into an eye in the center. This eye represents perseverance and determination throughout our lives.

content.text:
## Shattered Glass Fractals

  

The late great Javier Ontiveros, my master and the man who taught me fractals, taught me how to work with Apophysis, how to create symbol fractals -- such as for the art on "Perseverance" -- and then especially, how to work fractals into organic environments. This showed even more strongly when I developed the technique for what I've called "shattered glass fractals".

  

After finishing the Fractal Sky designs, I returned to this technique to apply it to my own art. On the right, you're seeing "Endless Sunset" -- my favorite of the three I've created with the technique.

  

[Endless Sunset + Shattered Glass Fractals](endless-sunset)

  

* * *

  

With that, let's close this out with the final two Fractal Sky designs.
